text:
Dad, yesterday it rained

and today it rained a little while ago.

Even so, it is warm.

A good mushroom autumn should come.


Dad, the evening news will be on soon,

and the sauna is ready.


Father, come back to my dream.

I will give you bread, cheese,

berries.

I will fetch water from the spring.


Dad, let me practice again.

It is strange to be so unfeeling.

translation.title: Dad, Yesterday It Rained
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the domestic invitations to the dead father and the final self-accusation.
